name: Enogu Supply
description: Enogu Supply is a calm, photo-led WooCommerce block theme for an independent art-supply shop: paper, pigment, brushes and studio tools for illustrators and design students. The home page opens on three equal captioned photo columns that crossfade slowly, with the headline below the photos and a stats row, then four abutting rounded range panels under one light title, product tiles on pale grey, a vertical tagline story, a mill-order band with a slow parallax drift, the shop week as a spec table and six line icons. Manrope and Public Sans, a white ground, slate flat tabs and hairline-only orange. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours.
